title: Vanilla Toggle
description: This Mod Adds a vanilla toggle addition the default key bind is [V] you can change it in the settings you can toggle on and off
body: This mod allows you to toggle vanilla effects on and off using the [V] keybind. This keybind is changeable in your settings. If toggled on, it will set: [FOV Effects 100%], [Damage Tilt 100%], [View Bobbing ON], and [Particles ON]. If you toggle the mod off, your previous settings will be restored to what they were before.
